core.headline: Three-bedroom new-build semi-detached in Kings Hill
core.listing:
A new-build three-bedroom semi-detached house at Orchard Rise in Kings Hill, West Malling. The Larch house type is scheduled for completion in spring 2027 and comes with a 10-year NHBC warranty. The property has an air source heat pump and two allocated parking spaces with an EV charging point.

The ground floor has underfloor heating and comprises a living room measuring 4.90m x 3.30m (16'1" x 10'10") and a kitchen/dining room measuring 5.80m x 3.40m (19'0" x 11'2"). Upstairs there are three bedrooms and two bathrooms. The principal bedroom measures 4.10m x 3.00m (13'5" x 9'10") and has an en-suite.

Outside there is a turfed rear garden with patio and two allocated parking spaces. An EV charging point is fitted.

West Malling station is approx. 2 miles away. Full-fibre broadband is available.

Fixed Price £410,000, freehold with an estate charge of £295 per year. A reservation fee of £1,500 is required, deducted from the price on completion; refundable less a £250 administration fee if the buyer withdraws within 28 days, otherwise non-refundable. A developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring is available for reservations by 30 November 2026. Council Tax: not yet banded (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). Predicted EPC rating B. Construction is brick and block under a tiled roof. Mains electricity, water (metered) and sewerage; heating by air source heat pump with underfloor heating downstairs and radiators upstairs. The final EPC will be issued on completion. No onward chain.

Images show the show home; specification may differ. One exterior image is computer-generated (CGI) and indicative only.
core.summary: New-build semi-detached with air source heat pump, underfloor heating, EV charging and two allocated spaces at Kings Hill. Completion expected spring 2027, 10-year NHBC warranty, no onward chain.
keyFeatures: Air source heat pump with underfloor heating to ground floor
EV charging point and two allocated parking spaces
£5,000 flooring contribution for reservations by 30 November 2026
